practicalReflection: Conditional worth exhausts the heart because it keeps outsourcing identity. The turn is to live from being kept, not from being confirmed.

pressure.label: Under Pressure
pressure.title: When pressure makes worth feel negotiable again
pressure.issueStatement: The room tightens, the answer does not come, or the work is not received well, and suddenly worth feels like something you must win back before the day can continue.
pressure.centralInsight: Gurbani does not let response, praise, or performance decide your standing. Under pressure, the test is whether the soul still remembers whose word gives it place.
pressure.practicalReflection: Pressure makes worth feel transactional again. That is why the correction must be immediate: before rejection, silence, or criticism becomes a verdict on your existence.

practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: When worth needs a daily place to stand
practice.issueStatement: Even after insight, worth keeps drifting back into performance, response, and comparison. Without practice, the old bargain quietly returns.
practice.centralInsight: Gurbani roots worth in being held, called, and addressed by the One. The self becomes steadier when it is trained to receive its place from Naam rather than from applause or usefulness.
practice.practicalReflection: Worth rarely heals through argument alone. It deepens when the heart repeatedly stands where it can receive dignity without having to earn it first.
